FlexScriptClass.name: Particles.Emitter
FlexScriptClass.Summary: A placeable particle emitter. Holds the declarative spec (shape, motion, appearance); the singleton Particles.System reads every emitter and batch-draws its particles analytically at draw time, adding zero events to the simulation.

Description.p: Particles are a closed-form function of model time T (like kinematics), evaluated only when the scene is drawn, so emitters never slow the discrete-event simulation and are frame-skip invariant and deterministic per seedField.
The emission region is sized by the object's own resize handles; particle size is independent of object scale. Drop an emitter and it auto-creates the Particles.System.
Units: length = the model length unit, time = the model time unit. Angles are degrees.

Property.name: rate
Property.Summary: Emission rate, particles per time unit. Birth schedule: birth = startTime + i/rate.

Property.name: startTime
Property.Summary: Model time at which emission begins (0 = from run start). May be a number OR a FlexScript expression in the property; evaluated each draw.

Property.name: stopTimeField
Property.Summary: Model time at which emission ends (0 = never). May be a number OR a FlexScript expression.

Property.name: prewarm
Property.Summary: How far back to pre-simulate emission (in model time units), so the cloud is already full at reset / T = 0 (evaluates at T + prewarm).

Property.name: lifetime
Property.Summary: Particle lifetime in time units.

Property.name: lifetimeJitter
Property.Summary: Random extra lifetime per particle, between 0 and this value.

Property.name: shapeField
Property.Summary: Emission shape; use Particles.Shape (Point/Line/Disk/Plane/Box/Sphere). The region fills the object's resized footprint.

Property.name: directionField
Property.Summary: Launch direction mode; use Particles.Direction (Aimed = cone around the aim arrow / local +Z, Omni = all directions).

Property.name: coneHalfAngleDeg
Property.Summary: Spread: the half-angle (degrees) of the Aimed launch cone.

Property.name: speed
Property.Summary: Initial launch speed, length per time unit.

Property.name: speedJitter
Property.Summary: Random launch-speed spread, applied as +/- jitter.

Property.name: gravity
Property.Summary: Constant acceleration (length / time^2). Node-backed: read/write components, e.g. e.gravity.z = -9.8; or assign a whole Vec3.

Property.name: wind
Property.Summary: Additional constant acceleration (length / time^2), added to gravity. With drag > 0 it acts as a steady drift toward (gravity+wind)/drag.

Property.name: drag
Property.Summary: Exponential velocity-decay rate (1 / time). 0 = none; velocity carries a factor e^(-drag*age).

Property.name: swirlAmp
Property.Summary: Radius (length) of a circular wobble added to each particle's path, giving a corkscrew/spiral look. 0 = off.

Property.name: swirlFreq
Property.Summary: Angular frequency of the swirl, radians per time unit (period = 2*pi/swirlFreq).

Property.name: startColor
Property.Summary: Color (and alpha) at birth. Node-backed: e.startColor.r = 0.5; or e.startColor = Color.red;

Property.name: endColor
Property.Summary: Color (and alpha) at end of life. The particle color interpolates startColor -> endColor over its life.

Property.name: sizeStart
Property.Summary: Particle size (world diameter) at birth.

Property.name: sizeEnd
Property.Summary: Particle size (world diameter) at end of life.

Property.name: styleField
Property.Summary: Render style; use Particles.Style (Points = built-in soft dot, Sprite = the object's own image). Every particle is a camera-facing billboard.

Property.name: seedField
Property.Summary: Random seed for this emitter (determinism).

Property.name: disabled
Property.Summary: 1 = turn this emitter off (it produces no particles); 0 = active. The emitter's handle still draws while disabled, so you can find and re-enable it.

Property.name: statLiveCount
Property.Summary: Read-only: the number of live particles this emitter drew last frame.
